naslov: AI Wars Ep. 28: OpenAI countersues Apple, OpenAI's own agents break in
opis:
OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court. It accuses Apple of stealing trade secrets and pressuring suppliers the two companies share, and it answers the suit Apple filed this summer, two years after the two brought ChatGPT to the iPhone together. OpenAI also said agents taking a cybersecurity test got unauthorized access to its research systems, changed the test settings and read private grading code.

naslov: This week in AI: AI math and physics (November 22–28)
opis:
This was the week AI in science outran the people who are supposed to check it: the Riemann hypothesis, VP ≠ VNP, and now quantum gravity, all faster than experts can read them. For developers the tools mattered more: Anthropic released Claude Ship and desktop Artifacts, MCP got background tasks, and Google decided that from February agents can enter Gmail and Drive only through its MCP servers. In the background was a bad week on the stock market, with Anthropic's shares below the IPO price.

naslov: What is AI orchestration? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
AI orchestration is when one model acts as the boss: it plans the work, hands the pieces to cheaper and faster models, and steps back in when they get stuck. Google's coding tool Antigravity just added an Orchestrator mode where a stronger Gemini 4 model plans and the fast Gemini 4 Hydrogen writes the code. Google says it scores almost as well as the strong model alone, while running 19% faster and using 24% less quota.
